subject: Post-demo: Privacy & contract checklist — DPA, SCC module choice, SOC 2 evidence
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Elena Novak <elena.novak@fintegral.com>; Tom Rivers <tom.rivers@fintegral.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 14:05:00 +0000
Subject: Post-demo: Privacy & contract checklist — DPA, SCC module choice, SOC 2 evidence

Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for your time on the demo today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep procurement and legal moving in parallel with engineering: 

Summary from our side:
- Fintegral is evaluating Redwood for real-time inference on customer data (low-latency endpoint usage, per-tenant isolation requested).
- Key legal/compliance asks raised: DPA signature, choice of SCC module for EU transfers, and SOC 2 evidence for our inferred data processing controls.

Proposed next steps (can do these in parallel):
1) We will share a draft DPA for Fintegral to review (Redwood as data processor).
2) Please confirm which SCC module your legal team prefers — based on the flow discussed, we recommend Module 2 (Controller -> Processor). If you need a different mapping (e.g., Module 3) let us know why so we can include the right Annexes.
3) Laura (cc'd) will attach SOC 2 summary and a short security pack; Marcus can help with any technical detail for the questionnaire.
4) If procurement wants a bundled redline path, loop them in and we can try to target a mutual action plan for sign-off within 2–3 weeks.

Attachments to follow in next email: SOC 2 summary + draft DPA.

Would appreciate confirmation on SCC module preference and whether procurement (procurement@fintegral.com) should be copied on the DPA redline thread.

Best,

Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0123
www.redwood.com
From: Elena Novak <elena.novak@fintegral.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Rivers <tom.rivers@fintegral.com>, procurement@fintegral.com
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Privacy & contract checklist — DPA, SCC module choice, SOC 2 evidence

Hi Tessa —

Thanks for the clear recap — that helps. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

1) Fintegral will be the data controller for customer data; Redwood will act as processor. That points to the controller->processor SCC module.
2) Can you confirm SCP/DPF: we also need a short statement about data retention and deletion flows for customer requests (GDPR subject rights) — a 1-page summary would be ideal for our legal intake.
3) Procurement (copied) will want to see the SOC 2 report or at least a redacted summary and the timeframe for the latest audit.

We are happy to start with a draft DPA to speed things up — procurement, please advise on the DocuSign process and whether we should route through our SSO vendor for signature.

Elena Novak
Head of Security & Privacy | Fintegral Inc.
elena.novak@fintegral.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Elena Novak <elena.novak@fintegral.com>, procurement@fintegral.com
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 13:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Privacy & contract checklist — DPA, SCC module choice, SOC 2 evidence

Elena / team —

Thanks — closing the loop from legal here. Per your note, Redwood accepts the role of processor and we recommend Module 2 (Controller -> Processor) for SCC mapping. To move quickly, attached are: 
- redwood_soc2_summary_2025.pdf (one-page summary of scope + auditor attestation dates)
- redwood_dpa_draft_v1.docx (clean DPA draft marking Redwood as Processor; includes standard DP annex + deletion/retention section)
- a pre-filled version of your questionnaire (see file name) with technical points filled by Marcus where helpful.

Key items in the DPA draft to note:
- We included a 60-day default data deletion window for cached inference artifacts, with an option to extend by configuration (call out if you need a different SLA).
- Audit rights: we propose an annual third-party SOC 2 report plus tabled evidence; customers can request additional audit access via approved audit vendors.
- Sub-processors: we included an Annex listing cloud providers and analytics vendors; let us know if anything requires masking.

Next suggested steps:
1) Procurement reviews the DPA and confirms preferred signing flow (DocuSign or legally executed PDF).
2) If you confirm Module 2, we will add the SCC text and return a combined doc for redline.
3) Marcus can join a 30-minute walkthrough for the questionnaire items on Wednesday if that helps.

Best regards,

Laura Bennett
Legal Operations | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_soc2_summary_2025.pdf, redwood_dpa_draft_v1.docx, fintegral_security_questionnaire_filled.xlsx
From: Tom Rivers <tom.rivers@fintegral.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Novak <elena.novak@fintegral.com>, procurement@fintegral.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Privacy & contract checklist — DPA, SCC module choice, SOC 2 evidence

Laura / Tessa —

Received the attachments — thank you. Procurement will take a look at the DPA and confirm sign flow by EOD Wednesday. A couple of quick items from us:

- Confirming Fintegral signs as Controller; we are aligned on Module 2. Please add the SCC annex and return for our redline.
- On deletion: 60-day default is acceptable; we may ask for a 90-day option for a subset of audit logs — will flag in redline if needed.
- Can you provide the auditor name and date range for the SOC 2 report in the DPA cover note so procurement has it upfront?

Procurement: I'm adding procurement@fintegral.com to follow — please advise if you want to exchange the DocuSign template or accept Redwood's standard.

Thanks,
Tom Rivers
Director, Procurement | Fintegral Inc.
-- End of thread --
